content.text:
The official page is OpenAI's Deprecations page: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations. The old URL, platform.openai.com/docs/deprecations, redirects there.

**Next to be retired: October 23, 2026, one week from today.** All of these shut down that day:

| Models | Recommended replacement |
|---|---|
| `gpt-3.5-turbo` (including `-0125` and the completions variant), `o4-mini` (including `o4-mini-2025-04-16`), fine-tuned `gpt-3.5-turbo`, fine-tuned `o4-mini`, fine-tuned `babbage-002`, fine-tuned `davinci-002` | `gpt-5.6-terra` |
| `gpt-4` (including `gpt-4-0613`), `gpt-4-turbo` (including `gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09` and `gpt-4-1106-preview`), `gpt-4o-2024-05-13`, `o1`, `o3-mini`, fine-tuned `gpt-4` | `gpt-5.6-sol` |
| `o1-pro` | `gpt-5.6-sol` with `reasoning.mode: pro` |
| `gpt-4.1-nano`, including fine-tuned versions | `gpt-5.6-luna` |
| `gpt-image-1` | `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` or `gpt-image-2.5-flare` |

**After that:**
- **Nov 30, 2026:** the reusable prompts API (`v1/prompts`), the Evals platform and Agent Builder. Existing evals become read-only on Oct 31.
- **Dec 1, 2026:** `gpt-image-1-mini`, `gpt-image-1.5` and `chatgpt-image-latest`.
- **Dec 11, 2026:** `gpt-5`, `gpt-5-mini`, `gpt-5-nano`, `gpt-5-pro`, `o3` and `o3-pro`.

The page lists more entries running into 2027, which I haven't repeated here. The table comes from a summarized fetch of the page, so check the page itself before relying on exact dates or model names.
